name: The Empty Turnabout
source: Set in an alternate universe. Apollo Justice disappears after realizing that Athena Cykes, whom he had gotten a not guilty verdict for on the charges of murder, had actually committed the crime. Six months later, he calls Phoenix to watch him defend a man in a bizarre case where the body mysteriously vanished.
translation: 故事设定在平行宇宙。王泥喜法介在替背负谋杀指控的希月心音赢下无罪判决后，惊觉真凶竟然真的是她，遂悄然销声匿迹。半年后，他主动联系成步堂龙一，邀其旁听自己在一桩遗体离奇失踪的怪案中为被告辩护。
